civilization.headline: Launch holding strong — creator premiere is the only live coordination thread
civilization.synthesis: Test of Time is the healthiest title in the portfolio right now: sentiment is climbing (87% Steam, r/civ rallying), the Discord AMA passed with zero flashpoints, and the Lurkit quest is beating its cost ceiling. The one thing that actually needs a person is a scheduling decision — Open World moved the Time-Tested Civs multiplayer premiere to May 28, and the brand hero cut slipped, so the production thread needs a call on sequencing. Nothing here is escalation-grade; it's coordination, not risk.

borderlands.headline: D30 under gate — Phase 2 surge is paused and waiting on Davide's call
borderlands.synthesis: Every channel is converging on the same decision: Mad Ellie SP1's D30 cohort is at 9.8% against a 14% gate, so Tomás is recommending the Phase 2 paid surge hold until Patch 1.2 lands and the cohort re-measures. Heaven Media has paused paid, Gamesight is holding the creator seeding brief, and everyone is deliberately not firing spend against a paused layer. This is the cleanest example of the team self-coordinating around a gate — but the GO/NO-GO itself is Davide's, briefed June 5, timed to the Whispering Glacier endgame content beat window.

needs_you.text: Phase 2 paid surge is held pending Patch 1.2 + D30 re-measure — escalation drafted for Davide's June 5 GO/NO-GO.

wonderlands.headline: Encore date slip confirmed — re-announce comms need Davide sign-off
wonderlands.synthesis: The Glutton's Gamble Encore can't hit June 5: there's a reliable crash repro on the second-arena encounter transition, and the Eng Producer's realistic re-date is July 10. The marketing problem is the 65K standalone wishlisters who get a Steam notification the moment the date moves, so the comms framing is load-bearing. Marcus is drafting the re-announce — leading with stability-over-rush and a concrete July 10 target — and it needs Davide's sign-off before it goes out EOD Friday.
